title: Docs test result
description: One test's result, whatever ran it: a UI test, a code test, or another runner (written to output/results/<runner>.json as a list of these). report.html, the CI summary, the failure issue, saved results, and TEST-MATRIX.md read results. See codetests/results.py.

runner.description: What ran it: "ui" (Doc Detective), "code" (code_tests.py), or another runner's name, for example "param-tables".

kind.description: The kind of claim: "ui", a code test's claim kind (codetests/kinds/), or the runner's own, for example "parameter table".

claim.description: What the page claims that the test checks, in a sentence.

line.description: The test's line on the page, when its markup is on the page.

checked.description: What it checked, briefly, for the CI summary.

details.description: Link text for the test's section in report.html, unique to the test.

category.description: A failure's category, for example OUTPUT_DRIFT.

evidence.description: Links to what shows the result: a log, an extraction, a spec, a schema.
